form.name: Registry Name

urlHint.huggingFace:
Enter the base address of the upstream platform or mirror service, not a specific model or repository path.
Examples: https://huggingface.co, https://hf-mirror.com
urlHint.matrixHub:
Enter the base address of the MatrixHub instance, not a specific project or model path.
Example: http://<matrixhub-host>:<port>

urlDescription.huggingFace: Base address of the upstream platform or mirror service
urlDescription.matrixHub: Base address of the MatrixHub instance

urlRepositoryWarning.huggingFace: This looks like a specific resource path. Enter the base address of the platform or mirror service instead, e.g. https://huggingface.co
urlRepositoryWarning.matrixHub: This looks like a specific resource path. Enter the base address of the MatrixHub instance instead, e.g. http://<matrixhub-host>:<port>

form.usernameHint: Enter the upstream registry username and access token when pulling private models; robot accounts are supported.
form.verifyRemoteCertHint: Choose whether to verify the remote MatrixHub instance certificate during sync. Leave this unchecked when the remote instance uses a self-signed or otherwise untrusted certificate.
